map.不一样。预定利率是定价假设，保单实际收益率还要扣费用、考虑退保与死亡率偏差；监管: Not the same. The assumed interest rate is a pricing assumption, while the actual policy yield must also deduct fees and allow for surrender and mortality deviation; the regulatory cap on assumed rates exists precisely to prevent negative spread.

map.相反。折现率 i 越高，未来金额的现值越低；预定利率高对客户有利(领得多)，对现: The opposite. The higher the discount rate i, the lower the present value of a future amount; a higher assumed rate benefits the customer (they receive more), yet for present value discounting it pushes the value down.

map.：PV = 1000000/(1.03)²⁰ = 1000000/1.8061: : PV = 1000000/(1.03)^20 = 1000000/1.8061 ≈ 553,676 CNY. In other words, 1 million in 20 years discounted at 3% is worth about 554,000 today.
